snippet.title: We Competed in a 1v1 Cooking Challenge!
snippet.description:
We competed in a $30 BUDGET Cooking Challenge With an INSANE Punishment For The Loser!

After months of competing against each other in short-form videos, we decided it was time to take things to the NEXT LEVEL with our first-ever long-form Waterboyz YouTube video!

We each had just 1 HOUR to cook a full 3-course meal: an appetizer, entree, and dessert. Our three judges, Gage, Jodaci, and Devin, decided who cooked the better meal, and the loser has to face a DISGUSTING PUNISHMENT!

We hope you guys enjoy our first full-length video!❤️

If you enjoyed the video, LIKE and SUBSCRIBE for more crazy challenges, competitions, and videos like this!
